notes: Historical certified baseline reconstructed from the immutable 2026-08-23 WD freeze. It predates the 1,500-airport publication projection, so airport fallback is intentionally empty/fail-closed while airline/rule fallback remains certified. No data was fabricated to satisfy newer minima.

rationale.Entitlement Status: Required to state whether the allowance is included, conditional or purchased.
rationale.Applicability Conditions: Required to bind the rule to its governed fare/class/condition.
rationale.Weight Basis: Required to distinguish per-bag, combined-total and not-applicable weight semantics.
rationale.Fare Description: Optional editorial enrichment; governed Fare remains the factual identifier and UI has a neutral fallback.
rationale.Weight Status: Optional editorial enrichment; absence does not override the governed numeric weight field.
rationale.Weight Guidance: Optional editorial enrichment; UI derives numeric guidance from governed weight data and otherwise fails conservatively to check booking.
